records.title: Production Awards 2026
records.funding: Category-specific grants from EUR 6,500 to EUR 13,000
trust_notes: Official overview and detailed guidance contain conflicting birth-date ranges.
Automatic age matching is disabled and manual organizer confirmation is required.
Arabic application, agreement, guarantor obligations, cancellation terms, and IP document require human review.

records.title: Movimentos à Beira — Residência Artística no (en) Veras 2026
records.funding: BRL 3,000 honorarium, accommodation, airfare, and curatorial support
trust_notes: Application fee remains null because the official call does not explicitly state a fee.
Insurance, meals, local transport, production expenses, tax treatment, rights, and airfare limits remain unverified.

records.title: TaDA Residency Programme 2027
records.funding: Accommodation, workspace, travel, living-cost contribution, materials, partner infrastructure, and technical support
trust_notes: Application fee remains null because no fee is stated.
Living contribution, travel ceiling, visa, insurance, and accessibility support are unquantified.

records.title: BADA 2026 — Federal Call for Young Visual Artists
records.funding: Exhibition, direct-sales access, and curatorial support; cash support not stated
trust_notes: Exact closing time, booth costs, commissions, transport, installation, insurance, taxes, image rights, and travel support remain unresolved.

records.title: National Prizes for Scientific, Artistic and Literary Production 2020–2023
records.funding: ARS 3,000,000 first prize; ARS 2,000,000 second; ARS 1,200,000 third
trust_notes: Spanish sworn declarations control authorship, co-authorship, employment exclusion, and rights-holder eligibility.
Tax and broader rights implications require human review.

records.title: Berlinale Talents 2027
records.funding: No participation fee after selection; participants normally self-fund travel, lodging, and daily expenses
trust_notes: Early-bird application fee is EUR 10 through 19 August 2026.
Optional EUR 5 accessibility contribution does not affect selection.
No general travel or accommodation funding should be inferred.

records.title: Layali Al Sayfiya 2026
trust_notes: Artist fees and all travel, accommodation, production, equipment, insurance, and transport benefits remain unverified.

records.title: VILLÆ — French Diplomatic and Cultural Network Residencies
trust_notes: Stored in production but excluded from artist-facing search.
